title: Internal Accreditation
tagline: Mapping how 8 partner universities will accredit the PANORAIMA Masters — and where HAW needs to help.

ops_contact.name: Christine Wollmann
ops_contact.role: HAW EQA office — accreditation of study programmes

sections.title: What HAW will do
bullets: Collect the general requirements at consortium universities via the Excel query (accreditation status + responsible contacts).
Contact each partner promptly to ask when its accreditation process should start and which documents (programme description, module handbook, …) are required by when.
Create a PANORAIMA summary roadmap from the collected responses.

sections.title: Current status — and the open unknowns
bullets: Important to understand, as early as possible, how each PANORAIMA university runs its accreditation process.
Unknown #1: how many 'new' degree programmes PANORAIMA will ultimately create (clarified only at the end of WP2).
Unknown #2: how much of HCAIM's existing accreditation work can be reused.

sections.title: Roadmap for accreditation
bullets: Contact the responsible persons at every consortium university.
Inquire about each local process & lead time for programme and system accreditation.
Ask for (or compile) a checklist of documents that each university requires.

partners.action_text:
To clarify, Sofia University already holds program accreditation in Informatics and Computer Science.

Introducing a new program within this field requires approval at the Faculty level, followed by the University's Academic Committee and finally the University's Academic Council.

Once these approvals are secured, we only need to notify the National Accreditation Agency about the new program; a full re-accreditation is not required.

The entire process takes approximately 6 months at most.



However, if a list of documents for the complete accreditation process is needed for project purposes, we can certainly provide that.

partners.institution: National Technical University of Ukraine — Igor Sikorsky Kyiv
Università degli Studi di Napoli Federico II
partners.action_text: For a Master Program starting in the academic year 2026/27, we need a first proposal approved byour Department (Department of Electrical Engineering and Information Technology - DIETI) before 31.01.2026. In the case of a new activation, we must also acquire the opinion of the University QualityPresidium by that date. After the Department's approval, the Polytechnic School of Engineering and Basic Sciences should approve the proposal for the establishment/activation before 31.03.2026. Then, before 31.05.2026, the Academic Senate, subject to the opinion of the Board of Governors,has to express its favorable opinion on the creation and activation of this Master's Degree andshould approve its Regulations. Within the same date the Board of Governors should approve theactivation of this Master's Degree and express its favorable opinion on its Regulation. At the end of the process, our Rector will establish, for the academic year 2026/27, this newMaster's Degree together with its Regulation.

we will need to go through a validation process either as a new programme or as an update of an existing programme. With regard to accreditation (validation) it has not been agreed in the university whether it will be a new programme or an extension of the HCAIM programme. Please see page 21 9. Process Flow Charts 9.1. Validation of Programmes 30 ECTS Credits or Greater.

roadmaps.title: UNINA Federico II — AY 2026/27 Masters activation

phases.action: Approve first proposal of the new Masters.
Provide opinion on the new programme activation.

phases.actor: Polytechnic School of Engineering & Basic Sciences
phases.action: Approve establishment / activation of the Masters.
Express favourable opinion (subject to Board of Governors) and approve the programme regulations.
Approve activation and express favourable opinion on the regulations.
Formally establish the new Master's Degree and its Regulation for AY 2026/27.

roadmaps.note: Six sequential approvals with hard calendar deadlines.

hcaim_legacy.name: HCAIM — Human-Centric AI Masters programme
hcaim_legacy.description: A precursor EU-funded Masters programme that some PANORAIMA partners (TUD and others) already delivered. HAW's T2.3 task brief explicitly asks whether the accreditation groundwork done for HCAIM can be reused to shortcut PANORAIMA's own accreditation path.

flagged_by.quote: How was the topic of accreditation addressed in HCAIM? Is it possible to build on this for PANORAIMA?
It has not been agreed in the university whether it will be a new programme or an extension of the HCAIM programme.

hcaim_legacy.open_question: Should PANORAIMA be accredited as a new Masters or as an extension of HCAIM? Answer unlocks significant effort savings for TUD and potentially others.
